brief.description: A practical open sack of finished mineral fertilizer
brief.purpose: Distinct readable frontier supply in the shared resource family.
brief.silhouette: One squat open coarse flax-brown burlap sack of finished fertilizer with a broad rolled mouth showing pale gray-beige granules in four or five chunky patches. On the sack front a large simple desaturated dark green sprout stencil with two broad leaves, no letters. One side fold and short coarse woven marks across the cloth; not tiny mesh. Broad open mouth and green plant mark must remain unmistakable at inventory scale. Three-quarter view. No brass, no metal fittings, no second bag.

generations.prompt: Create one item: One squat open coarse flax-brown burlap sack of finished fertilizer with a broad rolled mouth showing pale gray-beige granules in four or five chunky patches. On the sack front a large simple desaturated dark green sprout stencil with two broad leaves, no letters. One side fold and short coarse woven marks across the cloth; not tiny mesh. Broad open mouth and green plant mark must remain unmistakable at inventory scale. Three-quarter view. No brass, no metal fittings, no second bag. High-resolution pixel-art master for a tiny Minecraft inventory icon, not a tiny output image. Clear broad silhouette, few major forms, crisp stepped edges and deliberately large color clusters. Material marks should occupy roughly 1-3 final pixels and stay lower contrast than structural edges. About sixteen purposeful colors, upper-left light, no gradients, microscopic detail, random noise, ground shadow, lettering, border or glow. Centered isolated item with generous margins on true transparent background. Reference image is STYLE ONLY: match the broad pixel clusters and readable material variation, not its subject, material or shape. Practical frontier craftsmanship in an alternate late nineteenth-century world; no ornamental brass or steampunk decoration.
